Academics Montverde Academy has been recognized by Niche as the No. 1 Most Diverse Private High School in Florida for three of the past five years and ranks #7 of 3,234 among the Most Diverse Private K–12 Schools in America. The Academy is also ranked #1 of 51 as the Best Private K–12 School in the Orlando Area. Academically, the Class of 2025 earned more than $15 million in collegiate scholarships, produced 40 Distinguished Scholars, and achieved a 100 percent college acceptance rate. Shine Like a Star! Fine Arts Montverde Academy offers an award-winning fine arts program and comprehensive college preparatory curriculum to young artists who represent a diverse, and gifted student body. Talented student artists focus on their passion for music, theatre, dance, and the arts in an immersive and intensive educational experience. UNPARALLELED ATHLETICS! Athletics Our athletics programs have earned notable distinctions that include 18 national championship titles and more than 60 student-athletes playing professionally. We offer 22 varsity sports programs and elite programs for boys basketball, boys soccer, tennis, golf, swim, and girls soccer. Montverde Academy offers a strong, competitive athletic program and belongs to the Florida High School Athletic Association (FHSAA). Athletic programs at Montverde Academy have achieved considerable local, regional, and national success.
